links.outcome: Gap between perceived accuracy and evidence-based grounding in medical RAG QA benchmarks
links.effect: Reveals an 'Accuracy Fallacy' in which a 14% gap separates perceived system success from evidence-based grounding.
links.quote: Our experiments reveal an ``Accuracy Fallacy", where a 14\% gap separates perceived system success from evidence-based grounding.

unlisted_practices: Independent evaluation of retriever and generator components in RAG systems with quadrant-based Context Utilization Efficiency metrics to diagnose retrieval versus generation errors

screen.reason: The paper introduces and benchmarks RAG-X, a diagnostic framework to evaluate whether medical LLM question-answering outputs are genuinely grounded in retrieved authoritative context versus exhibiting deceptive accuracy.

primary.practice: retrieval grounding evaluation and error diagnosis
